mechanism: Oracle frontier measurement for weight-multiplicity transfer across 248 type-and-height cells. 35 of 248 cells contained queries exceeding the frozen one-second oracle limit. The signed rank-7/rank-8 and E7/E8 surfaces do not fit the budget.
summary: Phase 0 measured all 248 type-and-height cells with 1,594,852 uncached oracle attempts. 135 cells filled every quota, 78 had incomplete yield, and 35 exceeded the one-second limit. E8 exceeded budget at height 1. The failure is cost, not symbolic disagreement.
lineage_note: No positive common height exists if rank 8 and every included type must be covered. Phase 1 is not authorized under Revision 3.
